Name: Shadowmere (TESIV version) horse recolor
Author: deleted86111548
Description:
Just a recolor of the horse sprite resembling Shadowmere from TESIV: Oblivion (the lilac one).

Please tell me if something is not working for you, it's the first time I created a mod.

I have the current versions of Stardew Valley, SMAPI and Content Patcher installed. Content Patcher is probably needed.

Downloads.Description: Reimagened the original horse sprite to make it look a little like Shadowmare as she looks in TESIV: Oblivion.
